gripOrHq.title: Badtimes
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Runner's MU is reduced by 2 until end of turn.

gripOrHq.title: Corporate Shuffle
gripOrHq.rulesText: Draw five cards, then shuffle a card stored in HQ into R&D. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

gripOrHq.title: Unlisted Research Lab
gripOrHq.rulesText: Draw an additional card at the start of each of your turns.

gripOrHq.title: Data Fort Remapping
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put a Remap counter on Data Fort Remapping when you score it. Remap Counter: End a run.

gripOrHq.title: Rockerboy Promotion
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [15] from the bank on Rockerboy Promotion when you rez it. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rockerboy Promotion. A: Take [3] from Rockerboy Promotion.

heapOrArchives.title: Bolter Swarm
heapOrArchives.rulesText: *Do 4 Net damage. *Runner cannot break any subroutines on the next piece of ice encountered during this run. If Runner has used a noisy icebreaker during this run, the cost to rez Bolter Swarm is reduced by [5].

discardCards.title: Forged Activation Orders
discardCards.rulesText: Choose a piece of ice. The Corp either rezzes that piece of ice or trashes it.

discardCards.title: Security Code WORM Chip
discardCards.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Trash a piece of unrezzed ice.

discardCards.title: Priority Wreck
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, pay any number of bits to force the Corp to lose that many bits.

scoreArea.title: Superserum
scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Superserum, remove all Virus counters, and avoid receiving the next two Virus counters Runner gives to you.

scoreArea.title: Unlisted Research Lab
scoreArea.rulesText: Draw an additional card at the start of each of your turns.

ice.title: Imperial Guard
ice.rulesText: *Trash a program. *End the run. If Runner has used a noisy icebreaker during this run, the cost to rez Imperial Guard is reduced by [5].

ice.title: Vortex
ice.rulesText: *If you pay [2], Runner is now encountering the outermost piece of rezzed ice on a data fort of your choice, instead of passing Vortex. The run is now considered to be a run on that data fort. If there is no rezzed ice on that fort, Runner is considered to have passed the last piece of ice on that fort.

ice.title: Deadeye
ice.rulesText: *Trash a program. *End the run. If Runner has used a noisy icebreaker during this run, the cost to rez Deadeye is reduced by [5].

root.title: Bolter Swarm
root.rulesText: *Do 4 Net damage. *Runner cannot break any subroutines on the next piece of ice encountered during this run. If Runner has used a noisy icebreaker during this run, the cost to rez Bolter Swarm is reduced by [5].
